description: V3 PHASE-GATED INVARIANT REGISTRY (ADR-0023). Registers all 30 invariants from docs/v3/verin-architecture-v3.md §17 with their phase gate and ACTIVATION state. HONESTY RULE: this file may only record whether an invariant is 'active' or 'not-yet-active' - it can NEVER store a pass/fail result. active-pass vs active-fail is COMPUTED by running each active invariant's mapped fitness mechanisms (scripts/v3-invariants.ts, blocking CI job 'v3-invariants'; registry integrity fenced by src/__tests__/fitness/v3-invariants.test.ts). A not-yet-active invariant renders visibly distinct from a passing one - never fake green (v3 §17 preamble). The 'documents' pins are verified by src/__tests__/fitness/arch-version.test.ts so build work cannot silently target a stale copy of the architecture; if a ratified document legitimately changes, update its sha256 here IN THE SAME PR and review every invariant below for drift.

gates.A: Foundation invariants 1-5 are active and green (Wave A, prompts 4-7)
gates.D: Proceed, blocked, and prohibited decisions replay byte-identically; decision-core invariants 6-13 green (Wave D, prompts 16-19)
gates.E: A natural-language draft becomes simulated and approved structured policy; policy invariants 14-17 green (Wave E, prompts 20-22)
gates.F: Concurrent, repeated, failed, and delayed execution paths are safe and recorded; approval/execution invariants 18-25 green against fakes (Wave F, prompts 23-26)
gates.G/H: The full journey uses real Salesforce invocation and honest returned status; demo invariants 26-30 green (Waves G-H, prompts 27-29; Phase 1 completion). Prompt 27 is DEFERRED pending sandbox access (ADR-0024)

invariants.name: No PII-bearing type is reachable from llm/
invariants.activatesWhen: the llm/ surface and the Tokenized<T> scrubber-only factory land (Wave A prompt 6); the fence ships in that PR (import-reachability + factory-construction rule)
invariants.notes: Substrate today: contracts/pii.ts + scrub.ts + no-pii-in-audit-store fence + pino redaction (charter ADR-0006); the LLM surface is deliberately absent.

invariants.name: Every persisted record and repository operation is tenant-scoped
invariants.notes: org_id is the store-layer spelling of v3's FirmId (ADR-0026): every table carries org_id, every SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE must filter on it (AST-derived from the DDL). Prompt-5 decision contracts use structured tenant-scoped references and recursively reject any referenced configuration, source, policy, instruction, evidence snapshot, intent, input bundle, derived decision, approval template, role, subject, scope, execution target, reservation, or verification rule whose FirmId differs from the enclosing record.

invariants.name: No core module, directory, or evaluator branch is named for a decision domain
invariants.activatesWhen: the decision-core subsystems are scaffolded inside the four layers (Wave A; ADR-0026/marriage-map C6); the naming fence ships with the first decision-core module. PRE-CONDITION: the ADR-0010 account-opening flow definition migrates to config/domains/ (Wave B prompt 10, marriage-map C10) before this can go active-green

invariants.name: Import boundaries match v3 §16
invariants.activatesWhen: the §16 module subsystems exist; each v3 dependency rule (decision/ never imports llm/, no module imports config/, ...) lands as a ts-morph fence in the wave that creates its subject (ADR-0026)
invariants.notes: Substrate today: the four-layer dependency rule is already fenced (src/__tests__/fitness/dependency-rule.test.ts); §16 modules will live INSIDE those layers.

invariants.name: Ledger records are append-only
invariants.notes: The current ledger substrate is the hash-chained audit_log: BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE triggers RAISE EXCEPTION (migrations.ts), every write flows through the audited-write helper (fence), and the per-org chain is re-verified by the audit-chain-verify CI gate. The typed v3 LedgerEntry union + projections land ON this substrate (Wave A prompt 7).

invariants.name: Policy evaluation is a pure function of an immutable DecisionInputBundle and a deterministic engine version
invariants.activatesWhen: the input bundle (Wave C prompt 15) and the deterministic evaluator (Wave D prompt 16) land

invariants.name: A proceed decision cannot exist without authority and an execution plan
invariants.notes: Structural since prompt 5 (ADR-0029): ProceedDecision is a strict schema REQUIRING authority + executionPlan (src/contracts/decision-core/decision.ts); the fence proves the missing/empty variants are parse errors. Prompt 17 adds property tests over the evaluator.

invariants.name: A blocked decision cannot carry authority or an execution plan
invariants.notes: Structural since prompt 5 (ADR-0029): BlockedDecision is a strict schema with no authority/plan keys - a smuggled key is a parse error. Prompt 17 adds property tests over the evaluator.

invariants.name: A prohibited decision cannot carry a resolving condition, authority, or execution plan
invariants.notes: Structural since prompt 5 (ADR-0029): ProhibitedDecision/Prohibition are strict schemas with no authority, plan, or resolving-evidence channel, and a prohibited DecisionRecord admits no revaluation conditions. Prompt 17 adds property tests over the evaluator.

invariants.name: Precedence is order-independent and every conflict emits a trace
invariants.activatesWhen: the precedence engine lands (Wave D prompt 17) with shuffled-seed order-independence property tests

invariants.name: A decision with blocking evidence gaps cannot proceed automatically
invariants.activatesWhen: the validation stage lands (Wave C prompt 15; validate is distinct from evaluate - present-but-stale evidence cannot silently proceed)

invariants.name: Explanation is derived from the evaluation trace
invariants.activatesWhen: the evaluator + explanation trace land (Wave D prompt 16); WhyBubble becomes the renderer of ExplanationNodes (ADR-0028, marriage-map §2)

invariants.name: Replay from the pinned bundle is byte-identical under canonical serialization
invariants.activatesWhen: replay lands (Wave D prompt 19) with adversarial break attempts (live-source changes, reordering, TZ changes, engine upgrades)

invariants.name: No policy reaches approved without a recorded simulation run
invariants.activatesWhen: the policy lifecycle lands (Wave E prompt 20: draft -> simulated -> in_review -> approved -> active -> superseded)

invariants.name: No active policy is mutable
invariants.activatesWhen: the policy lifecycle lands (Wave E prompt 20; changes fork a new version, supersession preserves old replay)

invariants.name: Firm policy configuration contains no arbitrary executable code
invariants.activatesWhen: the constrained policy AST + load-time validator land (Wave B prompt 9: closed vocabularies; eval/dynamic-import/SQL/shell/user-functions rejected at load time)

invariants.name: LLM output cannot directly activate or bind policy
invariants.activatesWhen: the NL policy path lands (Wave E prompt 22: LLM output must survive AST validation, simulation, and attributed human approval before activation)

invariants.name: Every non-automatic approval stage defines role eligibility, quorum, actor-distinctness, expiration, and escalation
invariants.activatesWhen: authority/approval stages land (Wave D prompt 18) on the FlowStep suspend/resume substrate (ADR-0011)

invariants.name: Approval invalidates on material input-bundle hash change
invariants.activatesWhen: approval binding to decisionHash + inputBundleHash lands (Wave D prompt 18; ApprovalInvalidated ledger event)

invariants.name: Every external execution step has an idempotency key and verification rule
invariants.activatesWhen: the execution planner and adapter conformance suite land (Wave F prompts 24-25), proving the required keys and rules are honored at execution
invariants.notes: Schema substrate today: ExecutionStep and CompensatingAction both require stable idempotency, conflict keys, reservation references, preconditions, and a verification-rule reference; the fence runs its required-key omission matrix against the STEP itself as well as against its compensation sibling (ExecutionStep re-declares its own strictObject around the shared shape, so a key overridden after that spread is invisible to the sibling's matrix - D-057), and rejects incomplete compensation and aliased parent/compensation keys. Every house-CRM write also carries an idempotency key with a replay-tested exactly-once effect (charter #16). The invariant remains not-yet-active until the planner and adapter conformance suite prove those contracts are honored by external execution.

invariants.name: Pre-execution revalidation occurs after approval and before external execution
invariants.activatesWhen: revalidation lands (Wave F prompt 23: refresh material evidence, rebuild bundle, invalidate stale approvals)

invariants.name: Conflicting pending or in-flight actions are considered through conflict keys and reservations
invariants.activatesWhen: conflict keys + append-only reservations land (Wave F prompt 23; reference failure: two simultaneous $75k requests individually valid, jointly overcommitted)

invariants.name: Every execution and status occurrence is recorded as a ledger event
invariants.activatesWhen: the typed LedgerEntry union (Wave A prompt 7) and execution events (Wave F prompt 25) land
invariants.notes: Substrate today: every store write is audited via the audited-write helper (audited-write-required fence); the typed execution/status event vocabulary does not exist yet.

invariants.name: A failure becomes a derived decision only when policy requires judgment; it never disappears into logs alone
invariants.activatesWhen: the event-driven exception loop lands (Wave F prompt 25: classify -> ExceptionDecisionRequested only when judgment is required)

invariants.name: Every real adapter and fake passes the same conformance suite
invariants.activatesWhen: the three-port conformance suite lands (Wave F prompt 24; the real Salesforce adapter is additionally gated by ADR-0024)

invariants.name: The identical $75,000 request produces different correct results for Firm A and Firm B with zero core-code change
invariants.activatesWhen: the full vertical is assembled (Wave G prompt 28: Firm B differs only through configuration)

invariants.name: The UI distinguishes blocked, prohibited, approved, submitted, and verified states
invariants.activatesWhen: the demo UI lands (Wave 0 prompt 3 begins it - docs/demo-design-language.md now authored per ADR-0028; demo-complete at Wave H prompt 29)

invariants.name: Every external status claim shown in the demo is backed by a real adapter response
invariants.activatesWhen: the real Salesforce adapter lands (Wave G prompt 27) - DEFERRED pending sandbox access (ADR-0024, captain directive 2026-07-26). Until the trigger fires, no external status claim may be presented as real (fake-backed claims stay provenance-labeled per ADR-0027), and Phase 1 is never declared complete

invariants.name: The constrained natural-language policy path results in a structured draft, simulation, approval, version activation, and changed replay outcome
invariants.activatesWhen: the NL policy path lands (Wave E prompt 22) and is demo-choreographed (Wave H prompt 29)

invariants.name: The printable decision record can be reconstructed entirely from ledger and replay artifacts
invariants.activatesWhen: the printable examiner-grade artifact is generated from ledger + replay data (Wave G prompt 28)
